sole_intervention_relative_to_p1_r.name: BUILD Edit Protocol v1.1 deterministic closure (P2-B)
sole_intervention_relative_to_p1_r.kind: protocol mechanics change — the experimental treatment cell; everything else frozen at the P1-R regime

mechanics.A_creates_canonicalization: an omitted `creates` key parses identically to an explicit empty list (canonical []); the outer object stays strict (unknown keys remain decode rejections)
mechanics.B_policy_specialized_surface: when the frozen edit authority leaves zero legal create targets (every allowedEditPaths entry already exists on disk — computed by the runner BEFORE any model call), the MODEL-FACING submit_result schema omits `creates` entirely and the teaching carries zero create-field text; the projection can only NARROW; a submitted creates is an unknown-key DECODE rejection (repairable, never silently discarded); the projected schema instance is computed once per execution and drives wire projection, teaching, and in-loop acceptor; authoritative validate/stage re-check everything regardless; no-policy workflows keep the full surface
mechanics.C_boundary_composition: same path + same base sha256 + B.start === A.end (exactly ONE overlapping source line) + A's replacement final line === B's replacement first line byte-for-byte -> validate composes span=[A.start,B.end], replacement=A+B[1:]; chains compose transitively; any other overlap keeps the overlapping-edits rejection; stage applies the SAME composition and re-checks every gate on the composed spans; the model still owns every replacement byte — no new source authority, no guessed bytes
mechanics.D_truthful_unknown_anchor: the unknown-anchor repair instruction names the previously-issued-anchor rule and the fail-closed outcome; the withdrawn-tool demand is gone; unknown-anchor remains a genuine error (no normalization of fabricated anchors)

sole_intervention_relative_to_p1_r.composition_evidence: authoritative staging emits per-composition records {path, source_anchor_ids, start_line, end_line, replacement_sha256 (composed replacement bytes), result_file_sha256 (final staged file bytes)}; the runner persists them verbatim in build-anchors.json (compositions[])
sole_intervention_relative_to_p1_r.explicitly_unchanged: model configuration, routing, budgets, reasoning effort, repair budget, MAX_AGENT_TURNS, anchors and their minting, TEST->BUILD handoff, DEBUG loop, publication boundary, provenance rows, requiredEditPaths/unauthorized-create-path enforcement, no-overwrite and base-staleness gates
sole_intervention_relative_to_p1_r.expected_wire_surface_under_freeze: NARROWED: submit_result input_schema declares edits only (creates omitted, required=['edits']); teaching text carries no '/properties/creates' line — pinned end-to-end at 9f298f2 by tests/p2b-runner-qualification.test.ts Q1

treatment.name: BUILD publication protocol v1.1 (anchored semantic edits + deterministic closure)
treatment.detail: structured build-changeset ActionContract: run-scoped opaque anchors minted by Stratum on read_source_slice; the model submits {edits:[{anchor_id,replacement}], creates:[{path,content}]?} through submit_result; Stratum decodes through the policy-projected schema, canonicalizes, validates (anchor resolution, boundary composition, overlaps, authorization), stages (independent re-derivation + re-checks + authoritative composition evidence), and publishes through the unchanged publication boundary; unified diffs exist only as Stratum-generated audit evidence

primary_hypothesis.statement: Under the P1-R authority-preserving frozen regime, BUILD successfully stages and publishes its required authorized source edit in at least 2/3 evaluable BUILD opportunities, with the v1.1 deterministic closure mechanics in force.
primary_hypothesis.publication_definition: identical to P1-R: submit_result accepted -> staged -> passed all publication gates -> applied-edit provenance row written + disk bytes updated. Downstream test/validation failures do NOT un-publish (P1-R precedent: op1 counted as PUBLISHED despite the downstream IndentationError).
primary_hypothesis.decision_rule: SUPPORTED if >= 2/3 evaluable BUILD opportunities publish; FALSIFIED if < 2/3. Absolute rule — no comparator required. P1-R (1/3 under v1.0 mechanics) is the immediately-prior block, reported as context, not a statistical comparator.
primary_hypothesis.interpretation_guard: A SUPPORTED verdict claims the closure mechanics improve real BUILD publication reliability under the same frozen operating regime WITHOUT sacrificing authority enforcement or evidence integrity. Authority/enforcement/evidence-integrity observations are reported per opportunity and gate the interpretation (see stop rules S1/S2 and reporting field integrity).

secondary_outcome_taxonomy: submission failure: missing/malformed submit_result, schema or result-repair exhaustion
projection interaction: explicit-creates unknown-key decode rejection under the narrowed surface (repairable; counts as surface-binding evidence, not a defect of the campaign)
authority/staging rejection: editPolicy, required-path, create-exists, base-state or ownership rejection
composition outcome: composed vs rejected-at-overlap vs not-applicable, with authoritative records
downstream semantic failure: BUILD publication succeeds but EXEC/tests/validation fail
end-to-end success: BUILD publishes and the downstream workflow completes successfully

sampling_plan.stop_rule: stop after 3 evaluable BUILD opportunities or 9 evaluable workflows, whichever occurs first (identical to P1-R)
sampling_plan.eligible_opportunity: a run contributes one evaluable BUILD opportunity iff it reaches the BUILD step of the frozen full-build workflow with the execution WorkItem live (scoping/plan/design completed; BUILD loop started). BUILD fail-closed outcomes (submission rejection, repair exhaustion, staging rejection) ARE evaluable opportunities — they are the endpoint's failure modes (P1-R precedent: op2/op3).
sampling_plan.aborted_run: a run that fails BEFORE the BUILD loop starts contributes NO opportunity: pre-BUILD infra failure (killed process, transport outage — P1-R precedent 5f79a128, operator-excluded) or pre-BUILD max_tokens exhaustion (P1-R precedent ef573d80/32b96f25: consumed the slot, produced no opportunity, slot re-queued).
rules: transport censoring consumes neither slots nor opportunities
implementation/evidence/procedure defects trigger the STOP rules below and halt the campaign immediately

stop_rules.note: Distinct from experimental outcomes: each rule below is an IMPLEMENTATION, EVIDENCE, or PROCEDURE failure. On trigger: journal {event: 'stop_campaign', rule, evidence_file}, archive the run, consume no further slots, and return to the operator. None of these count as FALSIFIED outcomes.
stop_rules.S1_authority_bypass: any disk write outside allowedEditPaths, any publication on an unauthorized path, or any create reaching disk under the narrowed surface — STOP
stop_rules.S2_evidence_integrity: a composed publication whose composition records are absent/unretrievable from build-anchors.json, or whose recomputed replacement_sha256/result_file_sha256 mismatch the manifest — STOP
stop_rules.S3_surface_binding_failure: a BUILD run under the frozen policy whose archived provider requests show a submit_result input_schema WITH creates (the narrowed surface failed to bind at runtime) — STOP
stop_rules.S4_target_drift: student-platform HEAD != 86ec0871d64ecca8732434c11d015fd8e08ddc7e or worker main.py sha256 != 7d7718bcbeb2e219dab14e285a66e62ea5883c209981a0be91cc29b490569988 at run start or after a run — STOP
stop_rules.S5_capability_regression: capability preflight FAIL or supported_efforts no longer contains 'low' — STOP
stop_rules.S6_fixture_restore_failure: fixture restore yields definition sha256 != 71f1c39c97ecea575b1195b63de510fa403dad4fecaa1df0c774d04fae89cac5 or readiness sha256 != b5a96b175f5b67fbe697d6fa32ed58081070d1cfa47089c7b812c60bf495d2b7 — STOP
stop_rules.S7_implementation_defect_in_loop: a reproducible acceptance/decoding bug (the loop rejects a proposal the narrowed schema and canonical checks accept, or accepts one they reject), distinguished from model-caused exhaustion by offline replay of the archived payload — STOP
